note: Per venue x name x weekend: Binance vs venue at the three fade bars (anchor = last US close bar, entry = 19:00 UTC bar the evening before the next US session, exit = 10:00 NY bar). dev = entry close / anchor close - 1 (bp); ret = exit close / entry close - 1 (bp, price only). Weekends 2026-01-30..2026-09-18, live shifted form. Rows exist only where both sides have all three bars. Venue candles fetched by one agent per venue from public endpoints and spot-checked by an independent agent (20-28 cells each, all exact); Gate's 23 pre-listing placeholder rows were re-fetched and replaced. Raw hourly CSVs (602,899 rows) are in the session scratchpad, not in the repo.

endpoints.hyperliquid: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info {"type":"candleSnapshot","req":{"coin":"xyz:<TICKER>","interval":"1h","startTime":<ms>,"endTime":<ms>}}; I asked for the window [target-1h, target+2h] and kept only the candle with t == target ms
endpoints.gate: GET https://api.gateio.ws/api/v4/futures/usdt/candlesticks?contract={SYMBOL}&interval=1h&from={unix_s}&to={unix_s} (public, no keys). Also GET /api/v4/futures/usdt/contracts/{SYMBOL} for quanto_multiplier and launch_time.
endpoints.kraken: GET https://futures.kraken.com/api/charts/v1/trade/{symbol}/1h?from={unix_s}&to={unix_s} (public, no keys; tick type 'trade' = traded-price candles; response 'time' is open time in MILLISECONDS)
